notes.title: Heart carrot update
notes.notes:
Happy Valentine's Day!

A Heart Carrot is added to game! It will often appear from 11 to 17 February, and much less often any other time.

notes.title: Snowman update
notes.notes:
Changes:

Added space snowman! Catch him and get 3 carrots! It will appear during 15 days before and after the new year. It can also be found any other time, though rarely.
Added hidden (and probably a little obvious) achievement.
Added electro field sound.


Improvements:

Reduced damage flash.
Selected buttons made brighter.
Reworked ship control - may feel some different, but mouse now works better.
